correctness.rationale: Every ordinary derivation of the cyclic right Leibniz algebra is determined by the image of e1 and has formula D=a1 N+Σ_{j≥2} aj S^(j−1). For a nonzero v with first nonzero index t, the shifted vectors Sv,...,S^(n−t)v form a basis of V_(t+1); the extra component a1 N v has leading coefficient t v_t. Thus the evaluation image equals V_t when t is nonzero in k and V_(t+1) when p divides t, giving necessity and sufficiency of the triangular, deleted-diagonal condition for every linear local derivation. Counting entries gives n(n+1)/2−floor(n/p); over characteristic zero no deletions. For an arbitrary nonlinear 2-local F, the derivation matching F(e1) is unique and thus matches all other vectors by every (e1,v) pair. Independently enumerated all 65,536 endomorphisms of F2^4, obtaining 256 linear locals and 16 ordinary maps. These finite checks cannot establish all fields.

value.rationale: This is a complete reflexivity and rigidity classification for an unbounded natural family of nonassociative algebras. The modular diagonal loss quantifies a sharp field-characteristic obstruction; moreover pairwise local compatibility restores a unique global derivation despite abundant pointwise-compatible non-derivations. The formula is mathematical structure, not a small numerical improvement.
